authorization: 사용자가 조사 범위를 모델 구현·학습·비교 실험으로 확장함
target: quantity at exact next hourly grid equals zero; current and target both observed
model_checkpoint_selection: early stopping by stop-set logloss, never by outside validation
decision_selection: global or current-state thresholds selected on policy set using same 0.01 grid for all models
probability_calibration: raw discrimination is reported; any calibration fits cal set only
later_test_gate: no Q3/Q4 scoring before saved selection; current user authorization includes the experiments, and development may continue on A/B/C
information_tracks: archived-weather sensitivity, not verified live vintage
data_admissibility: external features require historical coverage, station/time linkage, and source/publication timing record
performance_reporting: F1, precision, recall, AP, Brier, FP, FN, current-positive and low-quantity subsets, sample sizes, fit time and peak RSS
